description: Defines a 'Note' class representing a note with properties such as id, title, content, summary, and timestamps. Provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, copying with updates, and formatted date display.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A class representing a note with attributes like id, title, content, summary, creation and update timestamps, along with methods for serialization, copying, and formatted display.

methods.name: Note.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Note instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: Note.toJson
methods.description: Converts the Note instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: Note.copyWith
methods.description: Returns a new Note instance with specified fields replaced with new values.

methods.name: formattedDate
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly string representing the creation date of the note.
